summary: Zorgons-Thermora is a robust backend solution designed to tackle the challenge of harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS hot spots. We developed a clean, scalable .NET API with structured data transfer objects (DTOs) and containerized deployment via Docker to efficiently process, organize, and manage global burning activity data. Additionally, the solution highlights regions with potential natural or human-induced wildfire activities. This project enhances data reliability and accessibility, empowering researchers and stakeholders to monitor wildfire distributions accurately over time.
details:
What it does & How it works: A comprehensive full-stack platform combining an intuitive interactive web interface with a robust backend API. It processes and visualizes global wildfire hot spot data, offering regional insights (e.g., Amazon Basin, Sub-Saharan Africa), timeline tracking, and analytical breakdowns of natural versus human-induced fire likelihood.

Front-end Technologies: Interactive UI featuring dynamic charts, global views, and region-specific analytics.

Back-end Architecture: Clean separation of concerns with structured api/DTOs, high performance, and maintainability.

Tools & Languages used: C#, .NET, Docker, GitHub, and Web Front-end technologies.
